label: INTERNAL DIAGNOSTIC ONLY
config_rule: Reuse audited reference config through existing candidate_config; only independent method identifier, seed and run bookkeeping vary.
checkpoint_selection: per-rate-test-oracle; never describe as validation-selected or a deployable single checkpoint
changed: Each complete candidate mechanism transforms existing Local/forward Base/active Gap inputs to the original Flat adapter; native identity initialization or zero output bridges preserve the original start. Some methods intentionally modify only memory slots, as specified in their source cards.
interpretation: Different complete adaptations, not a matched-capacity mechanism ablation. No efficacy claim before completed metrics; no formal paper claim from adaptive test-oracle search.
promotion_rule: After all twenty seed66 runs are complete, select at most three methods with strictly higher full-precision mean8 than matched Flat for seeds67/68. Do not promote based on partial runs.
artifact_rule: Immutable code/data/source-card hashes, separate run directories, full-resume state, all eight BEST checkpoints and all negative results retained. No restart or source replacement of a running experiment.
